questions.question: Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.Statements:All lions are bears.Some lions are tigers.No lion is a horse.Conclusions:I. All bears are lions.II. No tiger is a horse.
options: Both conclusions I and II follow.
Neither conclusion I nor II follows.
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'C' (Neither conclusion I nor II follows.) है।

questions.question: Mayank starts from point A and drives 25 km towards south. He then takes a right turn, drives 29 km, turns right and drives 30 km. He then takes a right turn and drives 31 km. He takes a final right turn, drives 5 km and stops at point P. How far (shortest distance) and towards which direction should he drive in order to reach point A again?(All turns are 90-degree turns only unless specified.)
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'A' (2 km to the west) है।
